messages:
sara: hi team, submitting an ADA accommodation request for severe scent sensitivity. doc recommends scent-free environment or remote work. filing intake now.

rafa_peopleops: thanks for flagging, @sara. case opened HR-2026-192. looping @mike_manager @alex_fm @tara_hr to coordinate immediate options.

mike_manager: Sara, we can offer temporary remote while we assess. i'll look for a quieter desk or private office. will confirm by EOD.

alex_fm: filing facilities ticket FCL-2026-5560. can you list specific triggers (hand soap, floor cleaner, air fresheners)? that'll help vendor switch to low-VOC products.

facilities-bot: Ticket created: FCL-2026-5560 "Scent sensitivity accommodation". Assigned to alex_fm. Assessment ETA 2 business days.

tara_hr: @sara please complete the HR intake form (https://hr.redwood.example/intake?case=HR-2026-192) or request a confidential call. HR will draft an accommodation letter after intake.

legal-team: note: document offered options and employee preference. full scent elimination may not be guaranteed in shared HVAC spaces. consider remote as reasonable accommodation.

mike_manager: quick update — private office on 4F might be available Mon. reserving it pending facilities HVAC check unless you prefer remote.

sara: thanks all. please reserve the office while you check HVAC. if it's shared i'll start remote Mon. appreciate the fast response.

rafa_peopleops: noted. keeping the case updated in tracker HR-2026-192. DM any sensitive docs rather than posting here. :thumbsup:
